pageProps.title: 7 People 1 Role
pageProps.review: Renjo Mikihiko's novel 'I Was Murdered Seven Times' is an exciting mystery detective novel that gives readers a strong sense of immersion through a unique trick called '7 People 1 Role' and confessions from the suspects' perspectives.
pageProps.description: I was murdered seven times. One body, seven culprits, and seven mysteries.
pageProps.content:
## Review I was drawn to the book by its title. ```Renjo Mikihiko``` was already known to me through the book White Light. Actually, White Light wasn't 'very interesting' so I read this without much expectation for the author.
```I was murdered seven times``` - this one sentence explains this book. It was a trick-finding book to discover why the title is 7 People 1 Role instead of 1 Person 7 Roles.
It was an interesting and fun book that reads smoothly as the confessions and delusions from each suspect's perspective give readers more and more confusion. I should read Renjo Mikihiko's other works as well.
